Explanations: the DLI Grammar Reference Book.  ·  «The following verbs belong to the "Е" type of conjugation: думать, слушать, спрашивать … The verb лежать belongs to the "И" type of conjugation.» — DLI, Lesson 16. exercises.q: Наконец, как-то поздно вечером, он ___ (остановить / остановиться) перед Аней и сказал:
exercises.why: Антон Чехов · Анна на шее — Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее» (public domain). Explanations: the DLI Grammar Reference Book.  ·  «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs. The suffix "-ся" with these verbs indicates action of two or more actors upon one another … Verbs which never occur without the ending "-ся".» — DLI, Lesson 67. From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
